# Images that CI and the release pull, copied by .github/workflows/mirror.yml
# to ghcr.io/hinkolas/mirror/<name>:<tag> with the same digest. One Docker Hub
# image per line, pinned by tag and digest; the copy keeps the last path
# segment and the tag, so ghcr.io/hinkolas/mirror/postgres:17.11@sha256:...
# below. The workflow pulls each digest from the first of Google's mirror,
# Docker Hub, and (for official images) ECR Public that serves it.
#
# To bump an image: change its line here and push, wait for the mirror run,
# then update the references (ci.yml, release.yml, the release Dockerfile).

moby/buildkit:v0.34.1@sha256:99368f3e46177c6405b9740e4461d91cee004128daeecca78d4ceac50ec1da5c
